inlines.v: GUILT'LESS, adjective Free from guilt, crime or offense; innocent. The Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain. Exodus 20:7. 1. Not produced by the slaughter of animals. But from the mountain's grassy side A guiltless feast I bring.
